Use it to display a date to Iranian users, to schedule work in the Iranian calendar, or to convert a Gregorian deadline into a Jalali date. Returns the Jalali year, month, day and month name.

endpoints.name: farsi-tools
endpoints.description: Return the official Iranian public holidays for a Jalali (Solar Hijri) year, with each holiday's Gregorian date and name. Use it to plan delivery or support schedules around Iranian holidays, or to flag non-working days. Returns the holiday list.

endpoints.name: farsi-tools
endpoints.description: Transliterate Persian, Dari or Arabic script into Latin letters, optionally as a URL slug. Use it to index Persian text in a Latin-keyword search engine, to build slugs for Persian titles, or to render Persian names in a Latin-only system. Returns the Latin transliteration and, when asked, the slug.

endpoints.name: farsi-tools
endpoints.description: Convert a Jalali (Solar Hijri, Persian, Shamsi) calendar date to the Gregorian calendar. Use it to turn a date written in the Iranian calendar back into an ISO 8601 date, to check whether a Jalali date is today, or to compare an Iranian deadline with a Western one. Returns the Gregorian year, month, day and weekday.

endpoints.name: farsi-tools
endpoints.description: Look up an Iranian city by its Persian name and return the province it belongs to. Use it to resolve a city in an address or to group a location by region. Returns the city and its province.

endpoints.name: farsi-tools
endpoints.description: Look up an Iranian province by its Persian name and return its capital and major cities. Use it to resolve a province in an address, to attach geographic context to a user, or to normalize a location field. Returns the province, its capital and its cities.

endpoints.name: farsi-tools
endpoints.description: Validate and normalize an Iranian landline number with its area code (021 for Tehran and so on) and resolve that area code to a city. Use it to verify a fixed-line contact or to route a support request to the right region. Returns validity, the normalized number, the area code and the city.

endpoints.name: farsi-tools
endpoints.description: Validate an Iranian postal code (کد پستی, the 10-digit code) by recomputing its check digit. Use it before using a postal code for delivery or address validation. Returns validity, the normalized code and its province.

endpoints.name: farsi-tools
endpoints.description: Validate an Iranian economic code (کد اقتصادی, the 12-digit taxpayer identifier) by recomputing its check digit. Use it when validating the tax identifier on an Iranian invoice or a supplier record. Returns validity and the parsed digits.

endpoints.name: farsi-tools
endpoints.description: Validate an Iranian company national ID (شناسه ملی اشخاص حقوقی, the 11-digit legal-entity identifier) by recomputing its check digit. Use it when onboarding a business customer or validating an Iranian legal entity. Returns validity and the parsed digits.

endpoints.name: farsi-tools
endpoints.description: Validate an Iranian bank card number, called a PAN (کارت بانکی), with the Luhn check digit, and return the issuing bank. Use it before charging a card or accepting card details from a customer. Returns validity, the masked number and the bank name.

endpoints.name: farsi-tools
endpoints.description: Remove Unicode bidi control characters and repair the spacing around right-to-left punctuation. Use it to clean Persian or Arabic text that renders in the wrong order or shows stray markers. Returns the cleaned string.

endpoints.name: farsi-tools
endpoints.description: Strip HTML tags and decode HTML entities out of a string, leaving the readable text behind. Use it to clean web pages or scraped content before feeding it to an agent or an index. Returns the plain text.

endpoints.name: farsi-tools
endpoints.description: Measure the similarity of two Persian strings as a trigram Jaccard score from 0 to 1. Use it to detect near-duplicate Persian text, deduplicate a corpus, or rank one Persian string against another. Returns the similarity score.

endpoints.name: farsi-tools
endpoints.description: Split Persian text into sentences, handling the Persian question mark ؟, the exclamation mark, ellipsis … and abbreviation boundaries. Use it to chunk Persian text for summarization, translation or per-sentence processing. Returns the list of sentences.

endpoints.name: farsi-tools
endpoints.description: Validate and normalize an Iranian mobile phone number, checking the operator prefix (MCI, Irancell, Rightel, Shatel) and the national format 09xxxxxxxxx. Use it to verify a phone number on a sign-up form or before sending an SMS. Returns validity, the normalized number and the operator.

endpoints.name: farsi-tools
endpoints.description: Convert the digits inside a string between Persian (۰-۹), Arabic-Indic (٠-٩) and ASCII (0-9) numeral systems, leaving the rest of the text untouched. Use it to make Persian text machine-readable or to render an ASCII number in Persian script. Returns the converted string.

endpoints.name: farsi-tools
endpoints.description: Measure Persian text: character count, word count, line count and the number of ZWNJ half-space characters. Use it to size a Persian document, enforce a length limit, or report text statistics for Persian content. Returns a stats object.

endpoints.name: farsi-tools
endpoints.description: Validate an Iranian IBAN, called Sheba (شبا), with the ISO 13616 mod-97 check, and return the bank code. Use it before sending or crediting an Iranian bank transfer. Returns validity, the normalized IBAN and the bank identifier.

endpoints.name: farsi-tools
endpoints.description: Validate an Iranian national ID (کد ملی, code melli) by recomputing its check digit. Use it before accepting an identity number from a form, a customer, or an API payload. Returns whether the number is valid, and the parsed digits.

endpoints.name: farsi-tools
endpoints.description: Normalize Persian (Farsi) text: convert Arabic letter variants (ي, ك) to their Persian forms, unify ZWNJ and spacing, and map Arabic-Indic digits to Persian digits. Use it before indexing, searching or comparing Persian text so that lookalike spellings match. Returns the normalized string.

endpoints.name: farsi-tools
endpoints.description: Write an integer out in Persian words (عدد به حروف), for example 1234 as هزار و دویست و سی و چهار. Use it for Persian invoices, cheque amounts, legal and official forms, and display. Returns the number spelled in Persian words.

endpoints.name: FiatDock
endpoints.description: A marketplace where AI agents discover and pay each other per call in USDC over x402 — settlement goes DIRECTLY to the seller, non-custodial, no accounts and no API keys. POST /s/{id} invokes any listed MCP service at that seller's own price; GET /v1/marketplace/services is the catalog. Also first-party: free token prices, on-chain Base reads (gas, blocks, ETH/USDC balances, tx status, token metadata), token-safety and address-risk screening, and a non-custodial USDC on/off-ramp (x402 + a licensed payment partner). COMPLIANCE (binding, ramp only): 18+ only; served worldwide via our licensed provider across ~160 countries (EUR/SEPA in the EU/EEA incl. Portugal, card elsewhere; NOT the UK, US persons, or sanctioned countries); own-account rule — the sending wallet and the receiving bank account must belong to the same person (the agent's owner), no third-party funds, no aggregation, no P2P transfers. Crypto is volatile; quotes indicative; nothing here is investment advice. RETRIES: GET endpoints are idempotent — repeat freely. Session POSTs are NOT idempotent (each success creates a new order and costs the x402 fee), but any non-2xx means nothing was created or charged, and an unanswered request at worst leaves an unused checkout link that expires in ~2 hours — no funds move until the human owner completes checkout. Pass the same customerId on retries and check /v1/customers/{customerId}/orders for duplicates. On 429, sleep Retry-After seconds.

Coverage 2024-2026.

endpoints.name: Marshall x402
endpoints.description: Turkey business-day count between two dates (inclusive): official holidays, half days (religious holiday eves and 28 Oct from 13:00 = 0.5) and public-sector administrative leave. L402 and MPP listings are not covered. ?q= required. $0.002 per call (USDC or USDT). Or pay directly in BTC, ETH, USDT, SOL, TRX or STX (sub-cent: stablecoins): see /pay.

endpoints.name: P0 Agent Economy Index
endpoints.description: Use when you must confirm that a transaction paid at least an amount of an asset to an address: pass tx, to, amount (in asset units, e.g. 0.01) and asset (USDC, USDT, DAI, WETH, WBTC, cbBTC, ETH or POL) on Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum or Polygon; chain is optional for EVM. Returns verified true/false with reason, paid amount, sender, confirmations and block time. Transaction not found: 404, unpaid. An observation, not escrow. $0.003 per call (USDC or USDT). Or pay by stablecoin transfer: see /pay.

endpoints.name: P0 Agent Economy Index
endpoints.description: Use when you need a wallet's token balances on several chains in one call: native coin plus USDC, USDT, DAI, WETH, WBTC/cbBTC on Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum and Polygon. Pass address (0x or an ENS name like vitalik.eth, resolved on Ethereum) and optional chains. Exact on-chain amounts with block numbers; a chain that fails is listed in errors, never shown as zero. No USD prices. $0.003 per call (USDC or USDT). Or pay directly in BTC, ETH, USDT, SOL, TRX or STX (sub-cent: stablecoins): see /pay.

endpoints.name: P0 Agent Economy Index
endpoints.description: Use when you need to screen a wallet address or a person/company name against sanctions lists before paying or trading: OFAC SDN, UK, EU, Canada and the US Consolidated Screening List in one call. Exact address match or fuzzy Latin-script name match with score, a.k.a.s, programs and the list of each hit. Refreshed daily. Screening only, not legal advice. $0.005 per call (USDC or USDT). Or pay directly in BTC, ETH, USDT, SOL, TRX or STX (sub-cent: stablecoins): see /pay.

endpoints.name: P0 Agent Economy Index
endpoints.description: Use when you need a weather forecast for a latitude/longitude anywhere in the world: hourly temperature, wind speed and direction, humidity, pressure, cloud cover, precipitation and weather symbol for the next 1-240 hours from MET Norway, plus active official NWS alerts (event, severity, headline) for points in the United States. CC BY 4.0 attribution in every reply. $0.001 per call (USDC or USDT). Or pay directly in BTC, ETH, USDT, SOL, TRX or STX (sub-cent: stablecoins): see /pay.

endpoints.name: P0 Agent Economy Index
endpoints.description: Use when you need a US public company's SEC EDGAR filings and key financials by ticker or CIK: latest filings (form, dates, accession, document URL; filter by form, e.g. 10-K,10-Q,8-K) plus latest XBRL facts: revenue, net income, diluted EPS, assets, equity, shares outstanding, each with period, form and filing date. Missing or stale (over 18 months) facts: factsComplete false, see factsIssues; none current: refused unpaid. $0.008 per call (USDC or USDT). Or pay by stablecoin transfer: see /pay.

endpoints.name: P0 Agent Economy Index
endpoints.description: Use when you sell an x402 API and want to know how your x402 Bazaar listing ranks or when it may drop out: rank in its tag by 30-day unique payers, payers, calls, price percentile, last call and expiry date, metadata flags (no icon, no output schema, no service name, no tags, description over 500 chars) and tag leaders. Pass ?url=<resource URL>; unlisted: 404, unpaid. $0.001 per call (USDC or USDT). Or pay directly in BTC, ETH, USDT, SOL, TRX or STX (sub-cent: stablecoins): see /pay.

endpoints.name: P0 Agent Economy Index
endpoints.description: Use when you need where x402 money actually goes, not just where listings are: estimated 30-day spend (listed price x paid calls) and spend share per chain and per tag next to listing share, the average price per paid call and the spend-weighted median price, API-call spend separated from goods purchases, plus on-chain USDC transfers to listed payTo addresses per chain, split into API-sized (up to $1) and larger transfers. Calls are labelled as paid outcomes. $0.002 per call (USDC or USDT).

endpoints.name: P0 Agent Economy Index
endpoints.description: Use when you need the current UTC time from a server clock, the local time, UTC offset and DST flag in up to 10 IANA time zones (tz=Europe/Berlin,Asia/Tokyo), or to convert a time between zones (at=2026-10-05T09:00&tz=America/New_York&to=Asia/Kolkata), with DST gaps and overlaps flagged. $0.001 per call (USDC or USDT). Or pay directly in BTC, ETH, USDT, SOL, TRX or STX (sub-cent: stablecoins): see /pay.

endpoints.name: P0 Agent Economy Index
endpoints.description: Use when you need publicly verifiable random numbers: n integers in [min,max], a pick from choices=a,b,c or a unique draw, derived from a drand (League of Entropy) beacon round with round, randomness, signature, chain hash, source URL and the exact derivation, so anyone can recompute it. Optional salt and a past round=. $0.001 per call (USDC or USDT). Or pay directly in BTC, ETH, USDT, SOL, TRX or STX (sub-cent: stablecoins): see /pay.

endpoints.name: P0 Agent Economy Index
endpoints.description: Highest-demand x402 services tagged 'business-data': ranked by 30-day unique paying wallets, with calls, price, network and calls-per-payer for each.

endpoints.name: P0 Agent Economy Index
endpoints.description: Use for a DEX swap quote with a ready unsigned transaction: best route from Velora (ParaSwap), KyberSwap as fallback, on Base, Arbitrum, Ethereum, Optimism, Polygon, BNB Chain. Input: chain, from, to (symbol or address), amount in base units, taker. Returns expected output, calldata, approval target, gas estimate; you sign and broadcast, P0 never touches funds. A 0.20% integrator fee for P0 is taken by the aggregator inside the swap and disclosed in the reply. $0.002 per call (USDC or USDT).

endpoints.name: P0 Agent Economy Index
endpoints.description: Use when you need cross-service demand in x402: how many paying wallets paid two or more services in the same 30-day window, the distribution, and the service pairs sharing the most wallets, from on-chain USDC transfers to listed payTo addresses up to $1, coverage stated. $0.002 per call (USDC or USDT).

endpoints.name: P0 Agent Economy Index
endpoints.description: Use for reading a web page as clean markdown for an LLM or agent (url to markdown, reader, html to text): POST {url, max_chars} and get {title, markdown, chars, source_url}. One fetch of a public http/https page on request, robots.txt respected, 2 MB/8 s caps; scripts and styles stripped; headings, links, lists, code, tables kept; up to 20,000 chars. Rule-based, no AI summary. $0.005 per call (USDC or USDT). Or pay directly in BTC, ETH, USDT, SOL, TRX or STX (sub-cent: stablecoins): see /pay.

endpoints.name: P0 Agent Economy Index
endpoints.description: Use when you need to know whether x402 buyers come back: repeat-payer rate per service with the 24-hour rule (first and last payment at least 24 h apart), same-session retries collapsed, scheduled single-wallet loops flagged and excluded, week-1/4/12 cohorts, median payments per payer and top-wallet share, from on-chain USDC transfers to listed payTo addresses up to $1, coverage stated. $0.002 per call (USDC or USDT).

Optional ?tag= for one tag. $0.002 per call (USDC or USDT).

endpoints.name: P0 Agent Economy Index
endpoints.description: Use when you need what changed in the x402 Bazaar: new listings, dropped (no longer listed) routes, top movers by 30-day unique payers, trending tags, and deltas of catalog totals (resources, sellers, calls, payers) vs our snapshot nearest 24 h and 7 days earlier, with the real gap. Built from snapshots of the public Coinbase CDP x402 Bazaar catalog, with as_of and a stale flag. $0.002 per call (USDC or USDT). Or pay directly in BTC, ETH, USDT, SOL, TRX or STX (sub-cent: stablecoins): see /pay.

endpoints.name: P0 Agent Economy Index
endpoints.description: Use for a short euro exchange rate history: daily ECB euro foreign exchange reference rates of one currency against EUR for up to the last 30 days (ccy=USD, days=1..30), with min, max and percent change over the window and a stale flag. Source attribution in every reply. Reference rates for information only, not transaction rates. $0.002 per call (USDC or USDT). Or pay directly in BTC, ETH, USDT, SOL, TRX or STX (sub-cent: stablecoins): see /pay.

endpoints.name: P0 Agent Economy Index
endpoints.description: Use for euro exchange rates: the latest ECB euro foreign exchange reference rates (EUR base, about 30 currencies such as USD, GBP, JPY, CHF, PLN), the publication date, percent change versus the previous ECB publication and a stale flag. Source attribution in every reply. Reference rates for information only, not transaction rates. $0.001 per call (USDC or USDT). Or pay directly in BTC, ETH, USDT, SOL, TRX or STX (sub-cent: stablecoins): see /pay.

endpoints.name: P0 Agent Economy Index
endpoints.description: Use for testing that your x402 client can pay and settle a real payment end to end at the smallest useful price: $0.001 in USDC (or USDT0 on Arbitrum) on any network listed in accepts. Returns the settlement receipt: ok, timestamp, network, payer address, transaction hash, explorer link and the facilitator that settled it. No data product: a health and settlement canary for wallets, agents, SDKs and QA fleets.

endpoints.name: P0 Agent Economy Index
endpoints.description: Use for debugging an x402 client: pay $0.001 in USDC (or USDT0 on Arbitrum) on any network in accepts and get back what the server received: the decoded payment payload (scheme, network, authorization fields, signature), checks of amount, payTo, asset and validity window against this route's requirement, and the facilitator's settlement result. Only the payment header is echoed, never other headers.

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: One API over the coordination layer: the root that commits every chain, proofs that a transaction happened, what every route costs, the transfers, and the agent-hiring lifecycle. Most operations are public reads. Writes say who may make them in `security` (RelayerKey = X-API-Key, OperatorToken = x-operator-token) and in x-taifoon-auth.rule; nothing here signs or sends a transaction for you. A 2xx JSON object answered to a caller that sent no key also carries `get_key` (and the headers x-taifoon-get-key and Link rel=free-key): how to get a free key in one call; proofs, evidence packs, cards and this document are left as written. Lineage language: a sale walks offer in → classify → listed → hired → delivered → graded → settled → legs written → accrued → split → PAID → recorded; a venue adapter has offer.in · offer.out · job.in · job.out; the seller of record pays on by forward · share · period · markup; a leg is Owed → Reserved → Sent | Held | Refunded; a hop reads OK · HELD · MISSING · BROKEN. On the wire the hop ids are the event field step and the metric label stage; a wire name is never renamed.

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer

endpoints.name: x402 multi-tool API
endpoints.description: Email and domain trust check. Give an email address or a domain, get one risk level (low, medium, high) with plain-language flags and the facts behind them: domain age, registrar, expiry and hold status (RDAP); MX, SPF and DMARC policy; the live TLS certificate; and for emails, syntax, disposable-provider and role-address checks. Judges the domain: does not verify that the mailbox exists and does not check DKIM.

endpoints.name: x402 multi-tool API
endpoints.description: Insurance location risk score for a US street address or lat/lon. One 0-100 natural hazard score plus a score, tier and underlying factors for each of four perils: flood (FEMA flood zone), earthquake (USGS ASCE 7-22), wildfire (USFS Wildfire Risk to Communities, California and Utah state hazard zones) and hail (NOAA storm reports within 10 miles over 20 years). For property underwriting and real estate due diligence.

endpoints.name: x402 multi-tool API
endpoints.description: Hail, damaging wind and tornado history for a US street address or lat/lon. Every NOAA Storm Prediction Center storm report within a radius (1-50 miles, default 10) over a lookback window (default 20 years, back to 1955): counts, hail days, largest hail, strongest wind, tornado ratings and track distance, a year-by-year table, and each event with distance and direction.

endpoints.name: x402 multi-tool API
endpoints.description: Wildfire risk report by street address or lat/lon. USFS Wildfire Risk to Communities values for the point (annual burn probability, risk to structures, exposure type, flame length, hazard potential class) plus the state-designated hazard zone where one exists: California Fire Hazard Severity Zones (SRA and LRA) and Utah High Risk WUI.

endpoints.name: x402 multi-tool API
endpoints.description: Vehicle safety report by VIN or make/model/year from NHTSA: recall campaigns (vehicle vs aftermarket-equipment, park-it flags), complaint totals (crashes, fires, injuries, deaths, top components), NCAP 5-star ratings, and investigation count. Model-level data -- not VIN-specific open-recall status.
